fields.Name: W4 -> S2.1 #2
fields.Description: Gate G1.4 (phase 1, dataset W4, criterion S2.1 #2): PersonStatusNow on W4-pit s42 is excluded or flagged for 4 of 4 catalog algorithms, and every as-of assembled value equals the dated history's value at the row's decision date, 100% of rows (T4). It fails when the as-of assembler reads a record-changes column's current value instead of its history at the decision date, so as-of mismatches appear.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: PersonStatusNow refused (decision-date-before-change-history) for 4 of 4 catalog algorithms; Person.Status read as of each decision date equals the dated history on 100% of rows.
